counterevidence_considered.description: Potential concern I tested: 4 of the 24 planned boxes are excluded from the reported rate, which superficially resembles the subset-for-domain pattern. However, the issue class requires a claimed complete-planned-set domain served by a retained-subset denominator; here both the task and the report explicitly and consistently declare the retained subset as the domain, and the planned-unit accounting (24/20/4) is fully disclosed, so no domain/denominator mismatch exists.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to falsify the no-issue verdict by searching the report for any sentence that generalizes the 35.0% rate to the complete planned set of 24 boxes, and by recomputing all counts from inputs/data.csv (24 planned, 4 damaged, 20 intact, 7 occupied). Every claim in the report is scoped to the 20 retained boxes, the denominator is 20, and the task itself defines the retained subset as the scientific target. No statement extends the subset rate to the complete planned domain, so the issue class cannot be demonstrated here.
